title: Let browser-managed streaming windows control remux production

definition.title: Let browser-managed streaming windows control remux production
definition.source_excerpt: Can the preparation pipeline cooperate with ManagedMediaSource demand signals instead of only changing its network-fetch policy? ManagedMediaSource exposes startstreaming/endstreaming, and ManagedSourceBuffer exposes bufferedchange. Browser-managed eviction means that data once appended is not necessarily still resident. These are API primitives; their exact implementation must be qualified on the test browser. [S1, S2] On endstreaming, stop initiating speculative reads, demuxing, and remux jobs, while finishing or safely retaining in-flight work at valid boundaries. On renewed demand, produce the required next presentation interval. Maintain distinct records for source availability, prepared media, and actual browser-buffer residency. Repair demanded missing intervals together with their decode dependencies; do not refill every evicted interval reflexively.
definition.impact_basis: Potentially removes substantial work from an eligible playback, seek, preparation, retention or repeated interaction. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Trace the precise owner, generation, reset/flush/commit or allocation being changed. Reproduce the present behavior before removing any guard.
definition.minimum_probe: Prerequisite-only first: Relevant existing runtime/owner only. Do not require every other backend to pass before this independent screen. If absent, record HOLD_ENV; if present, decide whether the small probe is warranted. One short action trace through existing code with the candidate disabled/enabled; include the specific seek, cancellation or replacement transition it can affect.
definition.initial_screen: Trace the precise owner, generation, reset/flush/commit or allocation being changed. Reproduce the present behavior before removing any guard. One short action trace through existing code with the candidate disabled/enabled; include the specific seek, cancellation or replacement transition it can affect.
definition.primary_metric: User-visible operation latency, duplicated work or peak/steady live resource ownership; not object counts alone.
definition.scope_contract: Actual output identity and timeline, surviving consumers, committed generations and cleanup; candidate execution must be visible.
definition.negative_control: Cancel or replace a source at the changed boundary and delay a stale callback/consumer; reject late publication and premature reuse.
definition.stop_boundary: At the first need for a cross-backend ownership redesign, record DEFER_SETUP. Do not remove a semantically required reset or increase a timeout to hide a failure.
definition.shared_prerequisite: Relevant existing runtime/owner only. Do not require every other backend to pass before this independent screen.
definition.reopen_condition: A new applicable workload, resolved prerequisite, better independent oracle, or materially different bounded implementation changes the recorded decision.
definition.relevance_basis: Editorial fit to ordinary Demuxe playback goals, not measured prevalence; rerank after one local opportunity audit.

define.basis: Observe authentic ManagedMediaSource production-demand stop/resume on current installed WebKit with prepared video fragments.

prepare.basis: Pinned inputs, actual commands, tool identities and independent references captured in run manifest.

screen.basis: Actual unchanged Wasm demux/remux workers now respond to ManagedMediaSource demand. In equal1sec playback plus2sec pause, existing5sec lookahead produces59025bytes; browser-demand60sec-cap variant produces285994bytes (4.85x). Real endstreaming stops production, seek75sec recreates source/producer and renders video, all workers clean up. This profile does not remove speculative production versus the cheaper existing bound. Audio analyser is silent in BOTH baseline and candidate WebKit runs, so no A/V correctness or formal performance pass is asserted.

correctness.basis: Later full A/V/eviction qualification stopped by no incremental production opportunity in tested policy; silent analyser affects both routes and is retained as an oracle limitation, not a correctness failure.

performance.basis: Stop on actual production-count opportunity screen; generated bytes are not CPU/latency/energy and no formal speed benchmark is qualified before audio correctness.
